title: Ranking Rationale
altText: Official NIST AI RMF MANAGE 1 excerpt describing how assessed AI risks are prioritized, responded to and documented using impact, likelihood and available resources.
caption: NIST AI RMF MANAGE 1 ties prioritization to intended purpose, impact, likelihood, resources and documented residual risk.
credit: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, p. 32. Republished courtesy of NIST.
claimBoundary: Supports explaining the dimensions behind a risk ranking; it does not validate Build 028’s ranking method or any particular result.
